subject: Choosing cabinet finishes and handles
hook: The same charcoal door looks different at 9am and 9pm. So we test both.
ig:
The same charcoal door looks different at 9am and 9pm. So we test both.

Showroom lighting flatters everything. Your kitchen has its own light: a north-facing window, warm spotlights, pendant bulbs over the island. That is the light your doors will live in.

How we work through finishes and handles:

- Samples in your room. We bring them to you and lay them against your flooring and walls.
- Morning and evening. Ideally you live with a shortlist for a day or two.
- Handles on the actual finish. Gold on charcoal and gold on matt white are two very different kitchens.
- Whole-room view. The finish is applied to your 3D design so you see the full run.
- Confirmed in writing. Your choices go into an itemised quote before anything is made.

It adds a little time to the design stage and saves a lot of regret.

Comment SAMPLES and we will send you our kitchens page.
fb:
Here is something we always say at consultations: do not choose your kitchen finish under showroom lights.

We bring samples to your home, lay them on your worktop beside your floor and walls, and try the handles on the actual door finish. Then we show it all on your 3D design before it goes into an itemised quote.

If you can, keep the shortlist for a day and look at it again after dark. You would be surprised how often the favourite changes.
